ModMetaData.name: Ancient Hydroponic Farm Facilities (HSK Patched)
ModMetaData.author: MO - HSK conversion by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK-balanced fork of Ancient Hydroponic Farm Facilities by MO.
Player-craftable hydroponic buildings, dispensers, fermenters, sunlamps, pumps, storage tanks, and pipes rebalanced to HSK material economy:
FUNCTIONAL BUILDINGS (10): - Steel -> SteelBar across all costLists (HSK refined alloy) - HSK component pipeline added by tier: * Hydroponic basins, pumps, tanks: + ElectronicComponents + Mechanism * Sunlamp: + ElectronicComponents 2 + Microchips 1, Uranium -> DepletedUranium * Nutrient Dispenser: + ElectronicComponents 4 + Mechanism 4 + Microchips 2 * Nutrient Fermenter (top-tier): + ElectronicComponents 6 + Mechanism 6 + Microchips 2 * Feed/Outlet ports: + Wire (small electrical)
DECORATIVE LOOT CRATES (6): - Steel -> SteelBar (HSK refined alloy) - Mod's custom HydroponicNutrientSolution / MealNutrientPaste / Cloth / DevilstrandCloth contents preserved
Drop-in replacement - incompatibleWith upstream so they can't double-load. Switch back to upstream Workshop version when not playing HSK.
Credit to MO for the original mod.
